evidence: app/src/lib/format.js:1-33 — right-sized pure helpers, easily reused by any new section
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:22-34 vs abilities/[name].astro:15-25 vs types/[name].astro:29-38 — identical fetch/shape/404 scaffold copy-pasted per page

abstraction_design.rationale: The lib layer stretches well, but the resource-page scaffold and the card-list markup are copied rather than abstracted, so adding an Items section means duplicating ~35 lines of moves-page boilerplate.

findings.issue: Reimplements the pokemon→unique-species mapping (id extraction, MAX_MAIN_ID filter, fetch, dedupe) that lib/data.js:48-64 already owns as pokemonRefsToSpecies
findings.suggestion: Extend pokemonRefsToSpecies to carry through per-entry metadata (e.g. is_hidden) and make the abilities page consume it

findings.issue: Filter query-param serialization and the 'omit empty/default' rule are duplicated from index.astro:52-59, and the script depends on five hardcoded element IDs owned by index.astro
findings.suggestion: Single source of truth: either derive params from the form on both sides via one shared module, or move the client script into index.astro as a colocated Astro script

findings.issue: The fetch/shape/try-catch-404 page scaffold is copy-pasted in all four dynamic routes, so a new resource type (Items) duplicates it again
findings.suggestion: Extract a loadResource(name, path, shaper) helper in lib/ that throws/returns a not-found sentinel, keeping pages declarative

findings.issue: '<count> Pokémon' + card-grid list markup repeated identically in four routes with no shared CardList component
findings.suggestion: Add a CardList.astro (items + heading slot) and route all card lists through it, alongside PokemonCard

findings.issue: Every page's shaped data object is typed `any` (data, rows, relations), so refactors across page boundaries get no compiler support
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the shaped data (and API records) in lib/ and type Astro.props/data from them

findings.issue: Exported `apiBase` is dead code — nothing imports it
findings.suggestion: Delete it, or use it in the rare place a full origin is needed

findings.issue: Single 553-line global stylesheet means feature removal strands dead rules (.card-hidden, .move-list, .relations) and every page edit touches a shared file
findings.suggestion: Move per-feature rules into Astro scoped <style> blocks in the owning components/pages, keeping tokens + layout global

findings.issue: Feature removal leaves dead code: the `hidden` prop on PokemonCard.astro:14 and its CSS exist only for the Abilities feature
findings.suggestion: When removing a feature, grep for its props/classes and remove them in the same change

summary: A conventionally structured, current-Astro SSR app with a genuinely good lib layer (pure formatters, isolated API/cache module) and narrow-prop components; the card-sprite and data-source seams mean the highest-risk changes land in one file. Its weaknesses are duplicated domain logic (pokemon→species mapping, filter params, page scaffolding, card-list markup) and pervasive `any` typing, which push multi-file fixes and copy-paste onto the next maintainer. Solid, unremarkable, easy to navigate — 3.
